# shared-schema

**Research prototype - Not for clinical use.**

`schemas/simulation.schema.json` is the single source of truth for every entity
that crosses a layer boundary: `CatheterParameters`, `MaterialParameters`,
`ActuationInput`, `SimulationSettings`, `MeshMetadata`, `SimulationFrame`,
`ElectrodePose`, `ContactSample`, `ContactMetrics`, `SolverReport` and
`ValidationResult`.

* TypeScript interfaces are generated by `python scripts/generate_types.py`
  into `apps/viewer/src/generated/schema.ts`.
* The Pydantic models in `services/simulation-api` are checked against the same
  file at import time, so a drift between the two is a startup error rather
  than a runtime surprise.

Every numeric property carries an `x-unit` annotation. The unit is part of the
contract, not a comment.

Changing a field means bumping `x-schema-version` and writing a migration.
Fields are never silently repurposed.
